data.name: Mehranoush
data.gender_notes: Mehranoush is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'mehran', meaning 'light' or 'radiant'. The 'oush' suffix adds a feminine dimension, making the name Mehranoush, which signifies 'Radiant Light'. The name Mehranoush carries the meaning “Radiant Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Mehranoush usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of a soul, emphasizing the spiritual nature of the individual.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehranoush total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
